messages: Anya W: Small UX nit — the key icon in the Data Retention table rows is almost invisible on the low-contrast theme. Hard to spot when scanning multiple projects. :eyes: Mike L: Yup. Also screen reader doesn't announce anything — it's a decorative ``` Kai (Design): Quick CSS concept diff: ``` .key-icon { min-width: 16px; min-height: 16px; stroke-width: 1.5; color: var(--fg-strong); } .key-icon:focus { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px;} .tooltip { max-width: 240px; } ``` console-bot: Preview deployed: https://console-preview.redwood.ai/ops/1938765432/key-icon-a11y — please test. :rocket: Taylor P: I'll check with the compliance squad about adding key-id in the details panel vs in tooltip — they prefer details panel only (PII concerns). Anya W: Agree. Tooltip should be non-sensitive. Show 'BYOK' and region only; full key-id in key details modal. Kai (Design): I'll update Figma + handoff with tokenized strings for i18n. Assigning to Mike for engineering. Mike L: :thumbsup: I'll pick this up — will add unit tests for aria-labels and a11y checks. Putting a small PR tomorrow.
